"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

import rosterkit.models
import rosterkit.errors


# ---
def contact_rows(students):
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError("no students given")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    name_width = 0
    section_width = 0
    for student in ordered:
        name_width = max(name_width, len(student.display_name))
        section_width = max(section_width, len(student.section))
    rows = []
    for student in ordered:
        name = student.display_name.ljust(name_width)
        section = student.section.ljust(section_width)
        rows.append(f"{name}  {section}  {student.email}")
    return rows


# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import rosterkit.models
import rosterkit.errors
import rosterkit.contacts


def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    return rosterkit.models.Student(
        "id" + last, last, first, section, email
    )


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([
            make_student("Zed", "Zoe", "B", "z@x.org"),
            make_student("Li", "Amy", "10A", "a@x.org"),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Li, Amy  10A  a@x.org",
            "Zed, Zoe  B    z@x.org",
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        students = [make_student("Li", "Amy", "A", None)]
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError) as ctx:
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(students)
        self.assertIn("Li, Amy", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([])


# end of file
